Good afternoon, everyone, and welcome to the first special council meeting of 2026 on
January 5. Individuals interested in participating in today's meeting were eligible to register
online using the delegation registration form at www.kitchener.ca slash delegation or via
email at delegation at kitchener.ca. Any written comments received prior to the commencement
of today's meeting have been circulated to members of Council and will form part of the public record.
The meeting live streamed and archived videos are available at www.kitchener.ca
slash watch now. Before we begin this afternoon's meeting, I'd like to acknowledge that we're
gathering on the traditional territory of the neutral Anishinaabe and Haudenosaunee peoples.
We recognize our responsibility to serve as stewards of the land and honor the original
caretakers who came before us. We're communities enriched by the enduring knowledge and deeper
to traditions of the diverse First Nations, Métis and Inuit in Kitchener today.
Are there any disclosures of pecuniary interest?
There being none, and since there aren't any delegations,
we won't go into our delegation statement.
No mayoral business.
However, there is one item for in-camera meeting authorization.

All those in favor?
